name: direction-aware-tabs
title: Direction Aware Tabs
description: Tabs whose panel slides in from the side you are moving towards, with a sliding pill and an animated panel height.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The tabs, in order: { id, label, content }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Id of the tab that is open first. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new tab id whenever the selection changes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the slide and height change take.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
